FILLING OF A VACANCY IN THE OFFICE OF MEMBER OF THE ATTANAGALLA PRADESHIYASABHA UNDER SECTION 66A(1) OF THE LOCAL AUTHORITIES ELECTIONS ORDINANCE(CHAPTER 262)
WHEREAS the office of member of Attanagalla Pradeshiya Sabha has fallen vacant by reason of resigning ;

AND WHEREAS the Secretary of the Sri Lanka Freedom Party, the recognized political party to which RanasingheMudiyanselage Seelawathi Menike, the member belonged, was required by me under Section 66A(1) of the aforesaidOrdinance, to decide upon returned member if Sri Lanka Freedom Party who belongs to such party and is not disqualifiedunder Section 9 of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance and who shall be declared elected as a member within aperiod of thirty (30) days ;
AND WHEREAS the Secretary of the aforesaid recognized political party has communicated his decision tonominate Rajapaksha Welhenage Sudharshani to fill such vacancy ;

NOW THEREFORE Karunasingha Jayarathnage Sampath Madhawa, returning officer of the Attanagalla PradeshiyaSabha, acting in terms of Section 66A(1) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance (Chapter 262) do hereby declarethat Rajapaksha Welhenage Sudharshani was elected as the member of the Attanagalla Pradeshiya Sabha.
KARUNASINGHA JAYARATHNAGE SAMPATH MADHAWA,Returning Officer,Attanagalla Pradeshiya Sabha.
